_comment: Template only - never contains real credentials, safe to commit. Copy this file to sage_employee_puller.json next to the script (wherever you deploy it) and fill in real values there. The real one is gitignored (see .gitignore in this folder) so it can never be committed by accident. Full docs in README_CON.md.

companies._comment: One entry per Sage Company Number this host can serve - just a local DSN mapping + on/off switch. dsn must match a Windows ODBC DSN already configured on this PC (the same one the existing Excel/VBA payroll tooling uses). Everything else about this Company (Paypoints, Branch mapping, Amt column layout) lives on the matching Sage Payroll Company doctype in Frappe, not here - deliberately not duplicated in this file.
